description: This Java class provides various utility functions for formatting numbers, currencies, dates, and strings, mainly for use in JSPs within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilFormatOut
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for formatting numbers, currencies, dates, and strings, tailored for JSP output in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: safeToString
methods.description: Converts an object to string safely, returning empty string if null.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double number according to a specified format type and locale.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Overloaded method to format a BigDecimal number.

methods.name: formatPrice
methods.description: Deprecated method to format a Double or BigDecimal as a price string.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double or BigDecimal as a currency string based on ISO code and locale.

methods.name: formatDecimalNumber
methods.description: Formats a double into a string based on a pattern and locale.

methods.name: formatSpelledOutAmount
methods.description: Formats a number into its spelled-out string form based on locale.

methods.name: formatAmount
methods.description: Locale-aware formatting of a double amount.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Formats a percentage value from Double or BigDecimal.

methods.name: formatPercentageRate
methods.description: Converts a decimal percentage to a percentage string, optionally negated.

methods.name: formatQuantity
methods.description: Formats various numeric types into quantity strings.

methods.name: formatPaddedNumber
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zeros to a specified length.

methods.name: formatPaddingRemove
methods.description: Removes leading zeros from a string.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a SQL Timestamp into a date-time string.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date into a date string with optional format, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a Date into a date-time string with optional format, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: makeString
methods.description: Converts an object to string, encoding byte arrays as Base64, or returns empty string if null.

methods.name: checkNull
methods.description: Returns the string if not null, otherwise empty string; overloaded for multiple parameters.

methods.name: ifNotEmpty
methods.description: Returns pre + base + post if base is not empty.

methods.name: checkEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string among parameters.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a URL query string, replacing spaces and percent signs.

methods.name: encodeQueryValue
methods.description: Encodes a URL query value, replacing special characters.

methods.name: decodeQueryValue
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded query value back to plain string.

methods.name: encodeXmlValue
methods.description: Encodes special XML characters into entities.

methods.name: padString
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length with a character, either at the end or start.

methods.name: makeSqlSafe
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for SQL safety.

methods.name: formatPrintableCreditCard
methods.description: Masks all but last four digits of a credit card number with asterisks.
